item.title: Adding a free AI chatbot to a blogdown website
item.description: I wanted to add a small “Ask AI” window to this website. Visitors should be able to ask about my projects, publications or background and get a short answer with a useful link. Running it should cost nothing. I described my website setup to ChatGPT, followed its suggestions and discussed the parts I wanted to change. That covered choosing a provider, writing the code and adjusting the window for desktop and mobile.
